description: If the monadic finite search accepts a sentence \(\varphi\), a successful table of size at most \(B(\varphi)\) is a nonempty model of \(\varphi\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.decideSentence_sound {k : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Sentence)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.decideSentence φ = true) :
  ∃ d < Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.bound φ, ∃ T, Fin (d + 1) ⊨ φ
